name: recall-flashcard-app
description: Recall flashcard app: React frontend + Express/Prisma backend

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
